== Summary ==
A selfie by [[Scott Lingrell]] (centre) with [[Tamás Papp]] (left), [[Kevin Jaap]] and another player.

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]: a selfie posted from his own Slack account, and his face matches his [[:File:Scott Lingrell 2015 Hall of Fame.jpg|2015 Hall of Fame photo]]; [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day; [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo.

== Source ==
Posted in the #2024-worlds-bochum channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com), 2024-09-21. Original file name: 1000006096.jpg (3264×1836); Slack file id F07NG5W1UE6.
* '''Photographer / posted by:''' [[Scott Lingrell]] (Slack: Scott)
